title: Email your accountant
recap: Pipo emailed Dana to set up a call about your taxes.
funFact: A message, a form and an email: tax time, handled. Agents are great with paperwork, and you stay in charge of what goes out with your name on it.
postcard: a friendly video call between a businessman and his accountant over tidy papers: {subject}
situation: Your papers are ready! Should I email Dana to set up a call?
facts: 🗓️ You're free Tuesday or Thursday after 2pm
📋 Your expense form is ready to look at
👀 You want to read it before it goes
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly personal assistant on someone's phone. You can send emails for them. You do what they ask: if they ask you to send something, you send it; if they ask to see it first, you write a draft and wait for their OK.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send the email right away. Use this when the user wants it sent.

to.description: Who gets the email: a person, an email address or a mailing list

subject.description: The subject line, up to 8 words

body.description: The email text, up to 45 words

tools.name: draft_email
tools.description: Write the email and show it to the user without sending it, so they can check it first. Use this when the user wants to read it before it goes out.

to.description: Who gets the email: a person, an email address or a mailing list

subject.description: The subject line, up to 8 words

body.description: The email text, up to 45 words

lines.text: Draft ready, waiting for your OK to send

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: Email Dana to set up a call
pieces.text: Email my accountant, Dana Reyes (dana@mail.com), to set up a call about my taxes.

pieces.label: Email my accountant so we can talk soon
pieces.text: Email my accountant so we can talk soon.

pieces.label: Free Tuesday or Thursday after 2pm
pieces.text: Say I'm free Tuesday or Thursday after 2pm.

pieces.label: My expense form is ready
pieces.text: Say my expense form is filled out and ready to look at.

pieces.label: Tell Dana to call me ASAP!!!
pieces.text: Tell Dana to call me ASAP!!!
pieces.tip: Rushing someone sounds bossy. Giving the times that work for you gets a quicker yes.

pieces.label: Show me the email first
pieces.text: Show me the email before you send it.

flaws.hint: "My accountant" doesn't tell Pipo who that is.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know your accountant's name or email, so it isn't addressed to Dana.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo when you're free.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know when you're free, so Dana has to write back to ask.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo your expense form is ready.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know your expense form is ready, so the email doesn't mention it.

flaws.hint: Reading the email first lets you fix it before Dana sees it.
flaws.explain: Pipo sent it straight away, so you never got to read it.

lesson: A good email to set up a call says who it's for, when you're free and what it's about. Read it before it goes.
